input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Golden Hits"?

documents.text: The Magic of Boney M. – 20 Golden Hits The Magic of Boney M. – 20 Golden Hits is a greatest hits album by Euro-Caribbean group Boney M. issued in February 1980 which contained all their biggest hits up until that point, including non-album singles "Mary's Boy Child/Oh My Lord" and "Hooray! Hooray! It's A Holi-Holiday", key album tracks from "Take The Heat Off Me", "Love for Sale", "Nightflight to Venus" and "Oceans of Fantasy" as well as their most recent double A-side single release "I See A Boat On The River"/ "My Friend Jack" (Germany #5 and Norway#6).
